about: As Kril the hermit crab, you’ll need to wear the trash around you as shells to withstand attacks from enemies many times your size.
Embark on an epic treasure hunt to buy back your repossessed shell, and discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.
In this undersea society, trash is not only a way of life, but a valuable resource, used for everything from fashion to firearms.
But with the presence of trash comes a mysterious infection known as the Gunk, which could spell doom for the entire ocean.
summary: A soulslike adventure set in a crumbling underwater world.
